title: Clícalo Win32 key mapping
description: Physical mapping of every key of keys.json. Fixed keys carry the virtual key (Microsoft «Virtual-Key Codes») and the set 1 make code (Microsoft «About Keyboard Input», Scan 1 Make) of the reference layout. Layout-dependent characters are resolved when sending with the foreground layout (VkKeyScanEx).

referenceLayout.description: Keyboard layout identifier (KLID) the scan codes refer to.

vkName.description: Constant name in the Microsoft table (letters and digits have no VK_ constant).

scan.description: Last byte of the set 1 make code.

extended.description: The make code starts with the 0xE0 prefix (KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY).

prefixE1.description: The make code starts with the 0xE1 prefix (Pause). SendInput cannot inject it as a scan code.
